description: This PHP class 'DatabaseConnectionWrapper' encapsulates handling of database connections and error management for the OrangeHRM HRM system installer. It manages PDO connections, interprets specific error codes, and provides error messages related to database connectivity issues.

classes.name: DatabaseConnectionWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper for managing database connection status, error detection, and error messaging for the installer process.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the wrapper with a database connection and an optional error/exception.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Checks if there was an error during connection or operation.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns a human-readable error message based on the stored exception or error code.

methods.name: getThrowable
methods.description: Retrieves the Throwable instance representing the error or null if none.

methods.name: establishConnection
methods.description: Attempts to establish a database connection via the provided getter callback, verifying PDO extensions, and handling exceptions.
